name: open-pr
description: Write a short, plain pull request description a teammate reads in a minute: what changes, why now, what they must do. A script checks length, file-by-file bullets, AI tells, local paths and attribution; the user approves the text before the push and gh pr create or edit. Use for 'open a PR', 'update the PR body', 'this PR reads like AI'. Portable across SKILL.md-native hosts.
